spine: 1. Cassandra 從 Thrift 時代的 eventually-consistent NoSQL 起步、完全沒有交易，是本文要解決的起點問題。
2. 2013 年 Cassandra 1.2 引入 BATCH——同分區內原子且隔離，但用戶端產生的時間戳一旦打平，會用 cell 層級（非 row 層級）的 last-write-wins 解決衝突，可能拼出誰都沒寫過的值；跨分區更只保證最終原子性，完全不隔離。
3. 同年稍晚 Cassandra 2.0 的 LWT 用 Paxos 產生的唯一時間戳解決了同分區的 compare-and-swap 與時間戳平局問題，但受限於 grammar 完全無法跨越 partition 邊界，寫入會直接被拒絕而非只是不一致。
4. Accord 是 Apple 與密西根大學工程師打造、EPaxos 啟發的無 leader 共識協定，讓標記 transactional_mode='full' 的資料表獲得真正跨分區的 strictly-serializable ACID 交易（雖非互動式）。
5. 作者用自製工具 Monastery 在真正的三節點叢集上，以銀行轉帳情境實測 plain／BATCH／LWT／Accord 四種模式，量化每種模式在同分區／跨分區、盲寫／read-modify-write 情境下的失敗率——結果只有 Accord 在跨分區 read-modify-write 拿到 0/1000 失敗。
6. 但 Accord 並非完美：作者在同分區的盲寫測試中偶爾看到併發讀者讀到總和不等於 2000 的瞬間（例如 1851+1853），即使最終落地的資料永遠正確；這個懷疑後來被 Apple 工程師 C. Scott Andreas 在 ASF JIRA 上證實是真的 bug。
7. 13 年的演進路徑（BATCH → LWT → Accord）呈現的是逐步放寬「單一分區」這個限制，而測試方法本身——用併發讀者持續檢查不變量——才是真正能揪出這類瞬時隔離漏洞的方式。

perspective.mechanism: 四種交易模式（plain / BATCH / LWT / Accord）在同一份 CQL schema 上的實際差異：BATCH 靠 client timestamp 做 cell 層級 last-write-wins；LWT 靠 Paxos 產生的唯一時間戳做同分區 compare-and-swap；Accord 靠 EPaxos 啟發的無 leader 共識，讓條件判斷與讀取同時發生，因而能跨分區、且不受 LWT 的 stale-read-retry 問題所困。
perspective.tradeoff: 每往上一層解決一種問題就引入新的限制：BATCH 免費但只在同分區內安全、且對時間戳平局脆弱；LWT 解決了平局與 CAS，但結構性地無法跨 partition；Accord 解決了跨 partition，但仍非互動式交易，而且作者自己在測試中就撞到一個尚待社群確認、後來被 Apple 工程師證實存在的併發隔離 bug。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師若正在評估用 Cassandra 做強一致性的多資料表寫入（例如帳務、庫存扣減這類需要跨 partition 交易的場景），這篇文章給出的是「哪一種模式在什麼情境下會壞、壞成什麼樣子」的第一手併發測試證據，而不只是官方文件的宣告——包括 Accord 還在 6.0 未發布分支、且已知有一個未解的隔離異常。

notes.quote: The road to ACID transactions in Cassandra 6 ... By Phil Eaton August 16, 2026
notes.interpretation: 文章標題、作者 Phil Eaton、發布日期 2026 年 8 月 16 日。

notes.quote: Edit (August 17, 2026): C. Scott Andreas from Apple confirmed that we found an actual bug in Cassandra.
notes.interpretation: 隔天（8/17）的編輯附註：Apple 工程師 C. Scott Andreas 已在 ASF JIRA 上確認作者測試中發現的異常是真實 bug，不是測試腳本寫錯。

notes.quote: Cassandra has evolved significantly since its first release. From an eventually consistent data model without transactions and a schemaless, NoSQL interface over Thrift to where (in the upcoming 6.0 release) it stands as an ACID transactional SQL-like database (granted: severe SQL limitations, transactions are non-interactive, we'll get to that later).
notes.interpretation: Cassandra 的起點是完全沒有交易、schemaless、跑在 Thrift 上的 eventually-consistent 系統；6.0（尚未發布）才第一次具備 ACID 交易能力，且作者自己標注這個能力有嚴重限制（SQL 能力有限、交易非互動式）。

notes.quote: Accord transactions will become available only when Cassandra 6 is released (perhaps later this year), which is why we are using the pre-release branch.
notes.interpretation: 截至發文（2026-08-16），Accord 尚未隨正式版釋出，作者用「perhaps later this year」表示發布時間並不確定，因此整篇測試都跑在 pre-release 的 cassandra-6.0 分支上。

notes.quote: Batches, completed in their current form by Cassandra 1.2 (January 2013), let you combine a number of statements into one mutation per partition that is applied isolated and atomically. If the batch spans partitions, it also becomes a guarantee that the statements are eventually applied even in the face of node failures.
notes.interpretation: BATCH 於 2013 年 1 月的 Cassandra 1.2 定型：同一個 partition 內是原子且隔離的；跨 partition 時退化為「最終都會套用」的原子性保證，不包含隔離。

notes.quote: All statements in a batch share the same timestamp, where otherwise each statement has its own timestamp. Conflicts are decided by timestamp per cell, not per row. ... But timestamps are client-generated, and two clients can tie. Cassandra breaks a timestamp tie per cell by keeping the greater value, so two tied batches can each win some columns and lose others.
notes.interpretation: BATCH 的衝突解決是 cell 層級、不是 row 層級：時間戳由用戶端產生，一旦兩個 batch 撞上同一個時間戳，Cassandra 逐 cell 保留數值較大者，導致兩個 batch 的欄位被拆開重組。

notes.quote: 939  r1      sum(0) = 2000 or error  ({1847}, {1850}) +776 more ... 939 assertion(s) failed ... So, in this run, the concurrent reader saw mismatched balances 939 of 1500 times.
notes.interpretation: plain（無 BATCH／LWT／Accord）寫入在同分區盲寫測試中，1500 次併發讀取斷言裡有 939 次看到總和不等於 2000（約 62.6%）。

notes.quote: no assertion failures ... But run it a few more times and every few runs you'll catch a bad sum. ... 6  r1      sum(0) = 2000  ({1897}, {1893}) +3 more ... 6 assertion(s) failed
notes.interpretation: BATCH 在同分區盲寫測試中，多數執行是零失敗，但作者明確表示「每幾次執行就會撞到一次」，其中一次觀察到的失敗次數是 1500 次讀取斷言中的 6 次。

notes.quote: BEGIN BATCH USING TIMESTAMP 1755400000000000 UPDATE lab.tie SET balance = 100 ... UPDATE lab.tie SET balance = 1900 ... BEGIN BATCH USING TIMESTAMP 1755400000000000 UPDATE lab.tie SET balance = 1800 ... UPDATE lab.tie SET balance = 200 ... Neither batch wrote (1800, 1900), but that's what we get.
notes.interpretation: 手動構造的最小重現：兩個 batch 用同一個時間戳分別想寫入 (100,1900) 與 (1800,200)，實際落地結果是 (1800,1900)——一個兩邊都沒寫過的組合，直接證實 cell 層級 LWW 的危害。

notes.quote: 231  r1      sum(0) = 2000  ({10}, {1989}) +230 more ... 231 assertion(s) failed ... we indeed see atomicity preserved (each batch's writes were eventually applied together) but not isolation (concurrent reads saw mismatched balances).
notes.interpretation: BATCH 跨分區盲寫測試：1500 次讀取斷言中 231 次（約 15.4%）看到總和不等於 2000，證實跨分區只有最終原子性、沒有隔離。

notes.quote: According to the grammar, we can't even put SELECTs inside the BATCH. So the read stage is not even part of the "transaction". ... 831  r1      sum(0) = 2000      ({797}, {1210}) +166 more ... 1  check   ({1400})       ({1210}) ... 1  check   ({600})        ({797}) ... 1  check   sum(0) = 2000  ({797}, {1210}) ... 834 assertion(s) failed
notes.interpretation: CQL 文法根本不允許 SELECT 出現在 BATCH 內，所以 read-modify-write 完全得不到 BATCH 的保護：1000 次併發讀取斷言中 831 次錯誤，連測試結束後的最終落地結果（該是 600／1400）也錯了。

notes.quote: Lightweight transactions (LWT) came out in Cassandra 2.0 (September 2013) which gave us atomic compare-and-swap built on Paxos. We cannot atomically SELECT and then UPDATE, but we can at least atomically conditionally UPDATE. Also, LWT timestamps are derived from Paxos and are unique per partition, so timestamp ties that we saw in the BATCH workloads are just not possible when using LWT.
notes.interpretation: LWT 於 2013 年 9 月的 Cassandra 2.0 推出，基於 Paxos 提供原子的 compare-and-swap；因為時間戳由 Paxos 產生且同分區內唯一，BATCH 遇到的時間戳平局問題在 LWT 下不會發生。

notes.quote: One limitation of LWT is that while there is a way to know that a conditional update definitely failed, there's no way if the LWT times out to know if it succeeded or not.
notes.interpretation: LWT 的已知限制：逾時時無法判斷寫入究竟成功還是失敗，作者因此得在測試 schema 裡額外加 op 欄位當 idempotency token。

notes.quote:
$ ./monastery cql '127.0.0.1?consistency=quorum' rmw-lwt-same.cql
no assertion failures
notes.interpretation: LWT 在同分區 read-modify-write 測試中零失敗——1000 次讀取斷言與最終落地檢查全部通過。

notes.quote:
$ ./monastery cql '127.0.0.1?consistency=quorum' blind-lwt-same.cql
no assertion failures
notes.interpretation: LWT 在同分區盲寫測試中同樣零失敗（1500 次讀取斷言）。

notes.quote:
COUNT  CLIENT  ASSERTION  ERROR
400  w1      ok         Batch with conditions cannot span multiple partitions
400  w2      ok         Batch with conditions cannot span multiple partitions ... 800 assertion(s) failed ... So we've got LWT which can get us consistent read-modify-write within a single partition, but it doesn't work at all across partitions.
notes.interpretation: LWT 一旦跨 partition，Cassandra 直接以「Batch with conditions cannot span multiple partitions」拒絕寫入——兩個寫入者各 400 次嘗試、共 800 次全數被拒，這不是不一致，是結構性完全不支援。

notes.quote: Accord is the EPaxos-inspired leaderless consensus protocol that enables tables in Cassandra to be marked as transactional_mode='full'. All read and write operations on these tables go through the Accord consensus. And we finally get actual ACID transactions, albeit non-interactive ones. ... This is why the folks at Apple and University of Michigan created Accord.
notes.interpretation: Accord 是 EPaxos 啟發的無 leader 共識協定，讓標記 transactional_mode='full' 的表格獲得真正的 ACID 交易（但仍非互動式）；作者明白指出它是 Apple 與密西根大學工程師為了解決 BATCH／LWT 都補不了的跨分區缺口而做的。

notes.quote: In LWT, the value we read to use in the compare-and-swap would often be stale. The LWT would fail and we'd have to retry it. ... In Accord, the condition is evaluated at the same time as the read, so the read is not stale and the main reason a client would see a failure is due to a client timeout or a node failure.
notes.interpretation: LWT 的讀取與比較是分開兩步、讀到的值容易過期而導致重試；Accord 把條件判斷與讀取合而為一，讀到的值不會過期，失敗只剩下逾時或節點故障這類外部因素。

notes.quote:
$ ./monastery cql '127.0.0.1?consistency=quorum' rmw-accord-same.cql
no assertion failures
notes.interpretation: Accord 在同分區 read-modify-write 測試零失敗——1000 次讀取斷言全過，跟 LWT 打平。

notes.quote:
$ ./monastery cql '127.0.0.1?consistency=quorum' rmw-accord-cross.cql
no assertion failures ... That is entirely new in Cassandra 6 (or will be, when it is released). Very cool.
notes.interpretation: Accord 在跨分區 read-modify-write 測試同樣零失敗（1000 次讀取斷言），這是 BATCH／LWT 都做不到的組合；作者用「or will be, when it is released」提醒這仍是未發布功能。

notes.quote: While using Accord, I occasionally saw the concurrent reader report balances that didn't sum to 2,000. This only ever happened in the same-partition workloads. ... 1  r1      sum(0, 1) = 2000 or error  ({1851, 1853}) ... 1 assertion(s) failed ... However, I have never seen an error in the end result. There might be an isolation bug in concurrent transactions even while the durable result is not wrong.
notes.interpretation: 作者在同分區的 Accord 盲寫測試中偶爾看到併發讀者讀到總和不等於 2000 的瞬間（一次觀察到的具體數字是 1851 與 1853，總和 3704），但每次測試結束後落地的資料永遠正確；作者當時用「occasionally」「might be」表示這只是懷疑，尚未確認是不是真的 bug。

notes.quote: And lastly, I'm looking forward to getting help from the ASF JIRA on if these are actual bugs or if they're just mistakes in my own code.
notes.interpretation: 文章原始結尾明確承認：截至發文當下，作者自己也不確定是 Cassandra 的 bug 還是自己測試腳本寫錯，要等社群（ASF JIRA）確認——這正是隔天編輯附註（n02）要回應的懸念。

notes.quote:
Install Java 21 and the ant build system, and gcc and Go for our concurrent test runner Monastery. ... CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS lab WITH replication = {'class':'NetworkTopologyStrategy','datacenter1':3}; ... -Xms4G
-Xmx4G ... accord:
enabled: true
notes.interpretation: 測試環境：三節點本機叢集、NetworkTopologyStrategy 複寫係數 3、每節點 JVM heap 4GB、cassandra.yaml 明確打開 accord.enabled；併發測試工具是作者自製、開源於 github.com/theconsensuslabs/monastery 的 Monastery。

notes.quote: a reason Cassandra has so many (large) users including Apple, eBay, Bloomberg, and Netflix.
notes.interpretation: Cassandra 的既有大型使用者包含 Apple、eBay、Bloomberg、Netflix，用來說明交易能力的缺口是真實生產環境會遇到的問題，不是純學術議題。

notes.quote: Phil is the founder of The Consensus. Before this, he contributed to Postgres products at EnterpriseDB, cofounded and led marketing at TigerBeetle, and was an engineering manager at Oracle.
notes.interpretation: 作者背景：The Consensus 創辦人，曾在 EnterpriseDB 做 Postgres 相關產品、共同創辦並主導 TigerBeetle 的行銷、在 Oracle 當過工程經理。

notes.quote: Additionally, while LWT goes through Paxos, reads by default do not. The client executes CONSISTENCY SERIAL to indicate it wants SELECTs to go through Paxos. These reads can fail on a timeout as well so we assert the reads sum to 2,000 or that the read errors.
notes.interpretation: LWT 的讀取預設不會走 Paxos，必須由用戶端顯式送出 CONSISTENCY SERIAL 才會讓 SELECT 一起經過 Paxos；這類讀取一樣可能因逾時失敗，所以測試把讀取斷言放寬成「總和是 2000，或者讀取本身報錯」兩種都算通過。

notes.quote: BEGIN TRANSACTION \ LET x = (SELECT balance FROM lab.accounts WHERE customer = 1 AND account_id = 1); \ IF x.balance >= 1 THEN \ UPDATE lab.accounts SET balance -= 1 WHERE customer = 1 AND account_id = 1; \ UPDATE lab.accounts SET balance += 1 WHERE customer = 1 AND account_id = 2; \ END IF \ COMMIT TRANSACTION;
notes.interpretation: Accord 引入了 BATCH／LWT 都沒有的新 CQL 語法：BEGIN TRANSACTION 開區塊、LET 把一次 SELECT 結果綁成變數、IF...THEN...END IF 決定要不要寫入、COMMIT TRANSACTION 收尾；整段仍必須一次送出、不能中途跟應用程式互動，這是作者稱其「非互動式」的原因。

notes.quote: Monastery allows us to script concurrent operations on a database by a fixed number of clients. Monastery will run the script against the database for us.
notes.interpretation: Monastery 讓使用者用固定數量的具名 client（例如 w1、w2、r1）各自重複跑一段 CQL 腳本，語句後面用註解宣告該斷言什麼，藉此描述並執行「兩個寫入者＋一個持續讀取者」的併發情境。

notes.quote: Meanwhile the lack of joins plus automatic sharding (and a limited secondary index story) means a key characteristic has stayed the same: you model tables based on queries. And as a result your application might end up denormalizing, turning a single write into multiple writes in order to position the database to efficiently answer different queries later on.
notes.interpretation: Cassandra 沒有 join、自動 sharding 加上有限的 secondary index 能力，逼得應用程式依查詢模式設計資料表，常把一次邏輯更新拆成多次寫入到不同表（denormalization）——這是「跨 partition 交易」在 Cassandra 上特別現實的理由。

notes.quote: But again this is documented last-write-wins conflict resolution. ... Again, this is what the docs tell us will happen.
notes.interpretation: 作者兩次強調：不論是同分區時間戳打平、還是跨分區失去隔離，都是 Cassandra 文件已經寫明的預期行為，不是意外發現的 bug——這跟後面 Accord 那個被 Apple 工程師確認的漏洞性質不同。

notes.quote: Since the replication factor is 3 and there are only 3 nodes in the cluster, sharding will effectively not happen. But if we added more nodes to the cluster and kept the replication factor at 3, sharding would meaningfully happen.
notes.interpretation: 測試叢集的複寫係數等於節點數（都是 3），等於每個節點都握有全部資料，這次測試其實沒有真的做到 sharding；要是加進更多節點、複寫係數維持 3，sharding 才會真正發生——判讀整篇測試結果時要記住這個邊界條件。

notes.quote: The final check passed too, though after what we saw with tied timestamps that part is not quite guaranteed: if the last two batches tie, the durable end state can also mix.
notes.interpretation: BATCH 跨分區測試裡，測試結束後的最終檢查通過了，但作者提醒這不是保證——如果最後兩個 batch 剛好也打平了時間戳，連最終落地的結果都可能被打亂，不只是併發讀取瞬間看到的錯。

notes.quote: Both are unlikely in our happy localhost environment. ... The idempotency key would still be useful in a real system, but we'll drop it in our lab environment.
notes.interpretation: 作者明白提醒，Accord 測試裡幾乎不會撞到用戶端逾時或節點故障，是因為整個叢集只是本機三個 process、沒有真正的網路延遲，是一個「happy localhost environment」；op 欄位這種 idempotency key 在正式環境仍然有用，只是在這個實驗室設定裡被拿掉了。

notes.quote: This was my first exposure to Cassandra. I like it a lot. I like the builtin replication and builtin sharding. I like the novel consensus protocol and the strict serializability. It's interesting to see how it has evolved over the years.
notes.interpretation: 作者在文末說明這是他第一次真正接觸 Cassandra，整體印象正面：特別提到內建複寫、內建 sharding、新穎的共識協定與 strictly serializable 保證，覺得這套系統這些年的演進值得關注。

notes.quote: Even if this is a bug, it's not particularly damning. Distributed systems have bugs. And Cassandra 6 is not even released yet.
notes.interpretation: 作者對這個 bug 的嚴重程度做了自己的校準：即使真的是 bug，也不算特別致命——分散式系統本來就會有 bug，何況 Cassandra 6 都還沒正式發布。

notes.quote: It isn't cheating that plain updates and non-LWT BATCH updates won't use the idempotency columns because they can't use the idempotency columns.
notes.interpretation: 作者特別強調比較的公平性：plain 與非 LWT 的 BATCH 沒有使用 idempotency 欄位不是取巧，是它們的語法本來就沒有條件寫入能力，用不上這個欄位。

notes.quote: UPDATE lab.accounts SET balance = {x} WHERE customer = 1 AND account_id = 1 IF EXISTS; \ UPDATE lab.accounts SET balance = 2000 - {x} WHERE customer = 1 AND account_id = 2; \ APPLY BATCH;  -- assert ok or error
notes.interpretation: LWT 版本的盲寫轉帳測試用 IF EXISTS 這個最寬鬆的條件，把兩個 UPDATE 一起包進帶條件的 BATCH，讓寫入照樣走 Paxos、共用 LWT 的保護，即使邏輯上不需要真正判斷任何欄位值。

notes.quote: We will have only two accounts, with starting balances of 1,000 each. ... While the two writers are concurrently writing, we'll have a third thread reading concurrently and asserting that the sum of balances between both accounts is 2,000.
notes.interpretation: 測試工作負載設計：兩個帳戶各起始 1000、兩個併發寫入者互轉、第三個執行緒持續併發讀取並斷言兩帳戶總和恆為 2000——這個不變量是貫穿全文四種模式比較的正確性依據。
